[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Glossary[/color][/head]
Taypan is fought over by several powers, and each one has its own culture, chain of command, and way of speaking. Knowing who is who, and how to address them, will save your life and make your roleplay far richer.
This section is split by faction. Open a faction below to read about its ideals, its ranks and roles, and how its members expect to be spoken to.
[head=3][color=#684871]Divine Sol Mandate (DSM)[/color][/head] A feudal empire of nobles, knights, and levies. Proud, rigid, and honor-bound. See the [color=#684871]DSM[/color] page.
[head=3][color=#bf4d00]New Crescent Worker's League (NCWL)[/color][/head] A socialist union of workers and soldiers who threw off their masters. Egalitarian, numerous, and often underestimated. See the [color=#bf4d00]NCWL[/color] page.
[head=3][color=#535961]Shinohara Heavy Industries (SHI)[/color][/head] A Japanese megacorporation that fights for the balance sheet, polished on the surface and ruthless underneath. See the [color=#535961]Shinohara[/color] page.
[head=3][color=#ff7f7f]Taypani Free Stations Coalition (TFSC)[/color][/head] A company of pirate crews and corporations where strength rules and profit is king. The largest independent power in the system. See the [color=#ff7f7f]TFSC[/color] page.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]How to address them[/color][/head] For a quick reference on titles and honorifics across all factions, see the [color=#e8b04b]Forms of Address[/color] page under the Tutorial.
